Paragraph: "Raghava, as to how this monkey seems to be happy in meeting us, by way of his narration, and he too neared us as an aspirant of some deed to be performed by us, hence joining them seems to fulfil your mission...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Evaluating Hanuman's demeanor and assessing the viability of the alliance for Rama.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana points out Hanuman's joyful disposition as a sign of successful mission fulfillment.
Outcome/Resolution: Boosts Rama's confidence in the proposed partnership.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Lakshmana nurtures hope (asha-poshana) in Rama by highlighting auspicious signs.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Cognitive reframing: interpreting positive behavioral cues in an ally to alleviate despondency.
